key_concepts: Earth has four main layers: crust, mantle, outer core, and inner core.
Earth's layers differ in thickness, temperature, and composition.
The crust is the outermost and thinnest layer of Earth.
The mantle is the thickest layer of Earth.
The inner core is the hottest layer of Earth.
The crust is the coolest layer of Earth.
A volcanic eruption can be simulated by mixing vinegar and bicarbonate of soda.
The gas bubbles produced in the reaction represent erupting material from a volcano.
A paper cone around the bottle represents the shape of a volcano.
Volcanic eruptions involve the release of gas and liquid from inside a volcano.
